programs.title: Second Hand Husband
programs.desc: Gurpreet and Rajbir want to marry each other but Rajbir's compulsion to pay alimony to his ex-wife Neha seems a hurdle. To get rid of this constraint, they must convince Neha to marry someone.

programs.title: Call For Fun
programs.desc: Call For Fun is an edgy, coming of age laughathon revolving around the escapades of a young boy who takes over the reins of his father's business and faces a vortex of misadventures - mafia threats to client losses.
